name: Code input
summary: Six boxes for a verification code that move to the next box as you type and fill all at once when you paste, with a resend countdown and a wrong-code error.
use: for a one-time sign-in or verification code
a11y: The boxes are a labelled group, each input says which digit it is and points to the message, arrows and Backspace move between boxes, the first box offers one-time-code autofill, and the message is a polite live region.

use_when: a second sign-in step after a password, or confirming a new email or phone number
avoid_when: the first sign-in screen with email and password: use sign-in-form
a code longer or shorter than six digits: the six boxes are fixed in the markup, so a single text field fits better
a confirmation with no code to type: use confirm-dialog

parts.name: icon
parts.what: an icon for where the code was sent

parts.name: title
parts.what: the heading, such as 'Check your email'

parts.name: intro
parts.what: where the code went and how long it works, with the masked address in bold

parts.name: label
parts.what: the name of the code field

parts.name: boxes
parts.what: one box per digit, three, a dash, then three

parts.name: message
parts.what: help text, or the error when the code is wrong

parts.name: resend
parts.what: resend link with a countdown before it can be used

parts.name: change
parts.what: go back and use another address

empty.how: when any box is empty the Verify button is disabled; after a resend the boxes clear and the message explains what to do

loading.how: while the code is checked, disable Verify and the boxes and change the button text to 'Checking'

error.how: a wrong code turns every box red and shows the message with an alert icon; typing clears it

disabled.how: Resend is disabled during the countdown; Verify is disabled until all six boxes have a digit

overflow.how: the six boxes shrink with the card, and the card's padding gets smaller on a phone

long_text.how: intro and message wrap; the masked address never wraps, so keep it short
long_text.evidence: .odl-head strong { color: var(--ds-color-text-primary); font-weight: var(--ds-font-weight-label); white-space: nowrap; }

keyboard: Typing a digit fills the box and moves to the next one
Pasting a code fills all the boxes at once
Backspace in an empty box clears the box before it and moves there
Left and Right arrows move between boxes
Tab moves from the boxes to Verify, then Resend when it is ready, then Use a different email; Enter or Space presses the focused button
